text: Program Overview Mechanical engineering is the discipline that applies the principles of engineering, physics, and materials science for the design, analysis, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanicalsystems.The engineering field requires an understanding of core concepts including mechanics, kinematics, thermodynamics, materials science, structural analysis, and electricity. ProgramObjectives This program natures advanced engineering and technical personnel having basic knowledge and applied ability in machinery design and manufacture, and being able to work in the first line as to design and manufacture machinary, develop science, apply research, manage operations and other aspects in the fields of mechanical manufacturing. MainCourses Advanced Mathematics, Principle and Applications of Computer, Mechanical Drawing, Engineering Mechanics, Electrical and Electronic Technology, Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, Mechanic, Engineering Control, Electral mechanical integration Technology, Hydraulic Transmission, Mechanical CAD/CAM, Equipment Design, Technology of Mechanical Manufacture, CNC Technology, Single Chip and PLC Technology. Duration Four Years Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Internship Metalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc. Future Career Graduates will be capable to work in mechanical and traffic institutions, colleges, companies, focus on various mechanical and electrical products or microelectronic device’s research, design, manufacture, development, administration and so on. Now our graduates are employed extensively in large- and medium-sized manufacturing companies and research institutes. They are involved in mechanical design and manufacturing, technical innovation, applied research, project management, sales and marketing, etc.
